import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class SimpleNode<EdgeType> {
        List<EdgeType> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class SimpleEdge {
        int trg;
        SimpleEdge() {}
        SimpleEdge(int trg) { this.trg = trg; }
    }

    static class WeightedEdge<T> {
        int trg;
        T weight;
        WeightedEdge() {}
        WeightedEdge(int trg, T weight) { this.trg = trg; this.weight = weight; }
    }

    static class GraphBase<EdgeType, NodeType extends SimpleNode<EdgeType>> {
        List<NodeType> nodes;

        GraphBase(int size) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>(size);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                nodes.add(createNode());
            }
        }

        NodeType createNode() {
            return (NodeType) new SimpleNode<EdgeType>();
        }

        int size() { return nodes.size(); }

        int size(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id).edges.size();
        }

        NodeType get(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id);
        }
    }

    static class UGGraph<NodeType extends SimpleNode<SimpleEdge>> extends GraphBase<SimpleEdge, NodeType> {
        UGGraph(int size) { super(size); }

        void add1(int a, int b) {
            nodes.get(a).edges.add(new SimpleEdge(b));
        }

        void add2(int a, int b) {
            add1(a, b);
            add1(b, a);
        }
    }

    static class WGraph<T, NodeType extends SimpleNode<WeightedEdge<T>>> extends GraphBase<WeightedEdge<T>, NodeType> {
        WGraph(int size) { super(size); }

        void add1(int a, int b, T weight) {
            nodes.get(a).edges.add(new WeightedEdge<>(b, weight));
        }

        void add2(int a, int b, T weight) {
            add1(a, b, weight);
            add1(b, a, weight);
        }
    }

    static class MCMFEdge<T> {
        int trg;
        T cost;
        T adjcost;
        T flow;
        T cap;
        int dual;

        MCMFEdge() {}
        MCMFEdge(int trg, T cost, T cap, int dual) {
            this.trg = trg;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.adjcost = cost;
            this.flow = 0;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.dual = dual;
        }
    }

    static class MCMFGraph<T extends Number & Comparable<T>> extends GraphBase<MCMFEdge<T>, SimpleNode<MCMFEdge<T>>> {
        MCMFGraph(int size) { super(size); }

        void add(int a, int b, T cost, T cap, T rcap) {
            if (a == b) return;
            if (cap.compareTo(0) > 0 && rcap.compareTo(0) > 0) {
                add(a, b, cost, cap, 0);
                add(b, a, cost, cap, 0);
            } else if (rcap.compareTo(0) > 0) {
                add(b, a, cost, rcap, 0);
            } else {
                int da = size(a);
                int db = size(b);
                nodes.get(a).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>(b, cost, cap, db));
                nodes.get(b).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>(a, negate(cost), 0, da));
            }
        }

        private T negate(T x) {
            if (x instanceof Integer) return (T) Integer.valueOf(-((Integer)x));
            if (x instanceof Long) return (T) Long.valueOf(-((Long)x));
            throw new RuntimeException("Unsupported type");
        }

        static class pqitem<T> {
            int trg;
            T prio;
            pqitem(int trg, T prio) { this.trg = trg; this.prio = prio; }
        }

        Pair<T, T> augment(int source, int sink) {
            int N = size();
            T big = (T) (Integer) Integer.MAX_VALUE; // adjust for type
            if (big instanceof Long) big = (T) Long.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE);
            T[] upby = (T[]) new Number[N];
            T[] prio = (T[]) new Number[N];
            int[] preve = new int[N];
            PriorityQueue<pqitem<T>> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparing(p -> p.prio));

            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                prio[i] = big;
            }
            prio[source] = 0;
            upby[source] = big;
            q.add(new pqitem<>(source, 0));
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                pqitem<T> cur = q.poll();
                int curNode = cur.trg;
                T p = cur.prio;
                if (!p.equals(prio[curNode])) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < size(curNode); i++) {
                    MCMFEdge<T> e = nodes.get(curNode).edges.get(i);
                    T p2 = add(p, e.adjcost);
                    if (e.flow.compareTo(e.cap) < 0 && p2.compareTo(prio[e.trg]) < 0) {
                        prio[e.trg] = p2;
                        preve[e.trg] = e.dual;
                        upby[e.trg] = min(e.cap - e.flow, upby[curNode]);
                        q.add(new pqitem<>(e.trg, p2));
                    }
                }
            }

            T up = upby[sink];
            T upcost = 0;
            if (up.compareTo(0) > 0) {
                int cur = sink;
                while (cur != source) {
                    MCMFEdge<T> ed = nodes.get(cur).edges.get(preve[cur]);
                    MCMFEdge<T> e = nodes.get(ed.trg).edges.get(ed.dual);
                    e.flow = add(e.flow, up);
                    upcost = add(upcost, mul(e.cost, up));
                    ed.flow = sub(ed.flow, up);
                    cur = ed.trg;
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < size(i); j++) {
                        MCMFEdge<T> e = nodes.get(i).edges.get(j);
                        e.adjcost = add(e.adjcost, sub(prio[i], prio[e.trg]));
                    }
                }
            }
            return new Pair<>(up, upcost);
        }

        Pair<T, T> make_flow(int source, int sink) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size(i); j++) {
                    MCMFEdge<T> e = nodes.get(i).edges.get(j);
                    e.flow = 0;
                    e.adjcost = e.cost;
                }
            }

            T flow = 0;
            T cost = 0;
            Pair<T, T> up;
            while ((up = augment(source, sink)).first.compareTo(0) != 0) {
                flow = add(flow, up.first);
                cost = add(cost, up.second);
            }
            return new Pair<>(flow, cost);
        }

        // Helper arithmetic assuming T is Integer or Long
        private T add(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer) return (T) Integer.valueOf(((Integer)a) + ((Integer)b));
            if (a instanceof Long) return (T) Long.valueOf(((Long)a) + ((Long)b));
            throw new RuntimeException("Unsupported type");
        }

        private T sub(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer) return (T) Integer.valueOf(((Integer)a) - ((Integer)b));
            if (a instanceof Long) return (T) Long.valueOf(((Long)a) - ((Long)b));
            throw new RuntimeException("Unsupported type");
        }

        private T mul(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer) return (T) Integer.valueOf(((Integer)a) * ((Integer)b));
            if (a instanceof Long) return (T) Long.valueOf(((Long)a) * ((Long)b));
            throw new RuntimeException("Unsupported type");
        }

        private T min(T a, T b) {
            if (a instanceof Integer) return (T) Integer.valueOf(Math.min((Integer)a, (Integer)b));
            if (a instanceof Long) return (T) Long.valueOf(Math.min((Long)a, (Long)b));
            throw new RuntimeException("Unsupported type");
        }
    }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        U first;
        V second;
        Pair(U first, V second) { this.first = first; this.second = second; }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int M = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        int C = sc.nextInt();
        int D = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[K];
        int[] starts = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            starts[a[i]]++;
        }

        int maxT = K + N + 1;
        int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
        int src = V - 2;
        int sink = V - 1;
        MCMFGraph<Integer> g = new MCMFGraph<>(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (starts[i] > 0) {
                g.add(src, i, 0, starts[i], 0);
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; t++) {
            g.add(t * N, sink, 0, K, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                g.add(t * N + i, (t + 1) * N + i, C, K, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    g.add(t * N + u, (t + 1) * N + v, C + (2 * j + 1) * D, 1, 0);
                    g.add(t * N + v, (t + 1) * N + u, C + (2 * j + 1) * D, 1, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> fc = g.make_flow(src, sink);
        System.out.println(fc.second);
    }
}
